Class McpJsonRpcErrorTransport

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpJsonRpcErrorTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpStatelessServerTransport
public class McpJsonRpcErrorTransport extends Object implements io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpStatelessServerTransport
Wraps the stateless WebMVC transport of Spring AI so that a request for a method the server does not implement is answered with the JSON-RPC error -32601 Method not found instead of HTTP 500.

The SDK handler reports an unknown method as a failed Mono, and the transport turns every failure into HTTP 500 with a body that is not a JSON-RPC response. A client of a newer protocol revision probes with server/discover and falls back to initialize only on Method not found; ChatGPT receiving the 500 instead gave up on every query. With this wrapper the error carries the request id and arrives with HTTP 200, as JSON-RPC prescribes for the protocol versions the SDK implements.
